chunks: This is also invalidated by the miracles that appeared through the hand of Imam Ali al-Rida (peace be upon him), which indicate the validity of his Imamate, and these are mentioned in the books.

Because of them, a group returned from the belief of Waqf (stopping), such as Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, Rifa'ah ibn Musa, Yunus ibn Yaqub, Jamil ibn Darraj, Hammad ibn Isa, and others; and these are from the companions of his father who doubted him and then returned.

And likewise those who were in his era, such as Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa, and others who had said Waqf, they committed to the Proof and said with his Imamate and the Imamate of those after him from his offspring.
ai.seo_question: How did the miracles of Imam al-Rida affect the Waqifite sect?
ai.summary: This passage highlights how the public manifestation of Imam Ali al-Rida’s miracles served as definitive proof of his Imamate, compelling prominent scholars like Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj and Yunus ibn Ya'qub to abandon the Waqf doctrine. Their return from doubt to affirming his leadership and that of his descendants underscores the role of miraculous signs in resolving theological disputes within early Shia circles.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: Miracles shown by Imam Ali Ridha (a.s), which prove the rightfulness of his Imamate and which are mentioned in books of Shia and which also refute the beliefs of the Waqifite sect,

were the same through whose blessings some believers in Waqifite creed, like Abdur Rahman bin Hajjaj, Rifaa bin Musa, Yunus bin Yaqub, Jamil bin Darraj, Hammad bin Isa and others reverted from invalid beliefs. They were companions of the father of Imam Ali Ridha (a.s) and doubted about Imam Ali Ridha (a.s), but repented later.

In the same way, those who were present during the time of the Imam, like: Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Abi Nasr, Hasan bin Ali Washa and others; they also believed in Waqf [but seeing the proofs of Imam Ridha (a.s)] they accepted his Wilayat, became bound to him and accepted the Imamate of Imam Ali Ridha (a.s) and the Imams after him from his descendants.
